# SlideForge Skill

Generate Instagram/LinkedIn/TikTok carousels as HTML → PNG with AI-grade design systems.

<!-- Auto-generated by `slideforge skill-guide --write` — do not edit by hand. -->

## Quick Start

```bash
# Generate a single slide
slideforge generate-slide hero --primary-color '#4F46E5' \
  --params '{"headline":"Hello","subheadline":"World"}'

# Render a full carousel
slideforge render-carousel slides.json --tokens-file tokens.json --output carousel.html

# Export to PNGs
slideforge export carousel.html --output-dir ./exports --slides 4 --preset instagram_portrait

# Validate a carousel before shipping
slideforge validate-design carousel.html
```

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `slideforge configure-design` | Generate design system tokens from a primary color |
| `slideforge debug-layout` | Per-slide layout geometry report (bands, body region, text-stack vs available height). Same numbers the text-overflow gate uses |
| `slideforge embed-image` | Convert a local image file to a base64 data URI |
| `slideforge export` | Export rendered HTML slides to a directory of PNGs |
| `slideforge generate-slide` | Generate a single slide as HTML JSON |
| `slideforge list-archetypes` | List all available brand archetypes |
| `slideforge list-platforms` | List all available export platform presets |
| `slideforge list-slides` | List all available slide types with descriptions |
| `slideforge list-themes` | List all available visual themes |
| `slideforge mcp` | Start the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server |
| `slideforge preview-slide` | Render a single slide HTML to a PNG preview |
| `slideforge recommend-colors` | Recommend color schemes from a primary color |
| `slideforge render-carousel` | Assemble slide HTML objects into a full carousel HTML document |
| `slideforge session-setup` | Install the SessionStart hook so agents get a SlideForge dashboard at session start (AXI §7) |
| `slideforge session-start` | Print the session-start dashboard (recent decks + validator health) — the SessionStart hook target |
| `slideforge setup` | No-op (kept for CLI compat): the blitz renderer is embedded and needs no browser download |
| `slideforge skill-guide` | Load the design guide and skill documentation |
| `slideforge slide-info` | Get detailed info for a specific slide type |
| `slideforge slide-types-for-context` | Get slide types recommended for a specific context |
| `slideforge test-full-scope` | Run an exhaustive full-scope test generating 24 carousels covering all archetypes, themes, and slide types |
| `slideforge validate-composition` | Validate a carousel composition against arc structure and constraints |
| `slideforge validate-design` | Validate carousel HTML for design issues |
| `slideforge validate-layout` | Validate slide params before rendering |

## Slide Types

before_after_story, big_statement, case_study_result, chart, checklist_action_plan, column_chart, comment_cta, comparison, comparison_bars, definition, faq, funnel_chart, gauge, hero, image_callout, image_caption, image_collage, image_comparison, image_gallery, image_headline, image_quote, logo_cloud, metric_grid, myth_fact, pricing_plan, problem_solution, process_map, progress_rings, qr_destination, quote, radar_chart, scatter_plot, split_features, stat_row, table, testimonial_avatar, text_block, timeline

Run `slideforge list-slides` for per-type required params and variants.

## Platforms

instagram_portrait (1080×1350), instagram_square (1080×1080), instagram_story (1080×1920), tiktok_vertical (1080×1920), linkedin_landscape (1200×627), twitter_card (1200×675), facebook_post (1200×630), presentation_16_9 (1920×1080), presentation_4_3 (1024×768)

## Design System

1. Run `slideforge configure-design '#4F46E5'` to generate tokens
2. Pass `--tokens-file tokens.json` to `generate-slide` for consistent branding
3. Use `--typology` presets (e.g. `--typology startup --variant energy`) for curated style bundles
4. Gate every carousel with `slideforge validate-design <carousel.html>` before shipping
